Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at a rate λ(t), which is proportional to the number of infectious people I(t) = I1(t) + I2(t) and the transmission rate β.
Progression from the first to the second exposed stage at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the exposed state to the first infectious stage at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the first to the second infectious stage at a daily rate γ.

Name: π
Description: Susceptibility; the proportion of the population who is initially susceptible.

Name: λ_0
Description: Initial infection rate at time t=0.

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate of the epidemic at its start.

Name: σ
Description: Rate of becoming infectious; the daily rate of transition through exposed compartments (E1->E2 and E2->I1).

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery; the daily rate of transition through infectious compartments (I1->I2 and I2->R).

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection (observational model parameter).

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observation model.

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission (observational model parameter).
